digest.component_or_area: outbound parent write paths (CREATE emit and ACLI attach fallback)
propositions: CREATE emit path (_map_local_to_jira_fields) drops a non-epic parent silently with no durable bridge_alerts record, only a logger.debug that operators do not see
ACLI attach fallback (_attach_parent_guarded) swallows HTTP 400 on set_parent with only a WARNING log, never calling record_parent_divergence to record the rejection
A bound non-epic parent on CREATE must write to dropped_field_sink and emit outbound-field-dropped alert; an unbound parent must stay silent to avoid churn from convergence on later passes

The epic-only parent guard is unconditional in code but justified differently across vendors: Cloud rejects with HTTP 400, Data Center accepts and silently ignores, so suppression is correct on both and must not be vendor-conditional

Both slot 2 and slot 4 must be proven RED first with tests that fail for the missing signal before any fix, then turned GREEN by threading suppressed_out through OutboundMapper and adding record_parent_divergence calls
